([[West Haven, Connecticut]]) | college = [[LSU Tigers basketball|LSU]] (2017–2019) | highlights = *First-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] (2019) *SEC All-Freshman Team (2018) }} '''Tremont Waters''' (born January 10, 1998) is an American professional [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for the [[LSU Tigers basketball|LSU Tigers]] of the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC). ==Early life and high school career== Waters played for [[Notre Dame High School (West Haven, Connecticut)|Notre Dame High School]] in [[West Haven, Connecticut]]. He tried out for the [[Puerto Rico national basketball team]]'s U-17 squad in 2015.https://www.nhregister.com/colleges/article/Tremont-Waters-looking-to-earn-spot-on-Team-11353716.php As a senior, he was selected for the [[Jordan Brand Classic]]. He initially committed to [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]] but decommitted after coach [[John Thompson III]] was fired.{{cite news |last1=Halley |first1=Jim |title=Jordan Brand Classic: Tremont Waters testing the recruiting waters again |url=https://usatodayhss.com/2017/jordan-brand-classic-player-tremont-waters-is-testing-the-recruiting-waters-again |accessdate=July 17, 2018 |work=[[USA Today]] |date=April 13, 2017}} Ranked number 37 overall in his high school class by [[Rivals.com]], Waters committed to [[LSU Tigers basketball|LSU]] and coach [[Will Wade (basketball)|Will Wade]] on June 5, 2017.{{cite news |last1=Payne |first1=Terrence |title=Tremont Waters commits to LSU |url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2017/06/05/tremont-waters-commits-to-lsu/ |accessdate=July 17, 2018 |work=[[NBC Sports]] |date=June 5, 2017}} Waters was the 2017 Gatorade and Register State Player of the Year in Connecticut.{{cite news |last1=Borges |first1=David |title=New Haven’s Tremont Waters working to get better on and off the court |url=https://www.nhregister.com/sports/article/New-Haven-s-Tremont-Waters-working-to-get-12923680.php |accessdate=July 18, 2018 |work=[[New Haven Register]] |date=May 17, 2018}} ==College career== On November 22, 2017, Waters scored a season-high 39 points on 13-of-22 shooting in a 94-84 loss to [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]].{{cite news |title=Marquette beats LSU 94-84 for third in Maui |url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401000098 |accessdate=July 17, 2018 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 22, 2017}} As a freshman at LSU, Waters averaged 15.9 points, 6.0 assists and 3.4 rebounds per game. His 198 assists broke the school record for assists by a freshman set by [[Ben Simmons]]. Waters was named to the Freshman All-SEC team and was the Freshman of the Year in Louisiana. After the season, Waters entered his name in the [[2018 NBA draft]] but did not hire an agent to preserve his collegiate eligibility.{{cite news |last1=Lopez |first1=Andrew |title=LSU freshman guard Tremont Waters enters name for NBA Draft |url=https://www.nola.com/lsu/index.ssf/2018/04/lsu_freshman_guard_tremont_wat.html |accessdate=July 17, 2018 |work=[[The Times-Picayune]] |date=April 24, 2018}} He announced his return to LSU for his sophomore season on May 29, 2018.{{cite news |last1=Miller |first1=Brody |title=Tremont Waters returning to LSU for sophomore season |url=https://www.nola.com/lsu/index.ssf/2018/05/tremont_waters_returning_to_ls.html |accessdate=July 18, 2018 |work=[[The Times-Picayune]] |date=May 30, 2018}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2017–18 LSU Tigers basketball team|LSU]] | '''33''' || '''32''' || '''33.0''' || .417 || '''.351''' || .801 || '''3.4''' || '''6.0''' || 2.0 || '''.1''' || '''15.9''' |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2018–19 LSU Tigers basketball team|LSU]] | '''33''' || 29 || 32.4 || '''.429''' || .327 || '''.813''' || 2.8 || 5.8 || '''2.8''' || '''.1''' || 15.3 |- class="sortbottom" | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2"| Career | 66 || 61 || 32.7 || .423 || .340 || .807 || 3.1 || 5.9 || 2.4 || .1 || 15.6 {{S-end}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.lsusports.net/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=5200&ATCLID=211616615 LSU Tigers bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Waters, Tremont}} [[Category:1998 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Connecticut]] [[Category:LSU Tigers basketball players]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from New Haven, Connecticut]]
